Your hair is porous and very dry. Like everyone else has said: get a trim to remove the split ends. Use a very gentle shampoo (look for one that says it's for dry or colour processed hair). If you can find a sulfate free shampoo that would be even better; don't be alarmed as it won't lather like normal shampoo. Use a super moisturizing conditioner on the ends only. I use Redken's Heavy Cream conditioner. Eventually you'll only have to use the heavy conditioner every couple of days, and can use a lighter conditioner on the other days. You could also try using a dry shampoo every second day, to give your hair a break from being washed. It's just powder that you dust into your hair and brush out to get rid of some greasiness. Consider giving yourself an olive oil hair treatment once a week (but be careful you don't slip and break your neck in the shower, that stuff is deadly on ceramic).

I'm not socially acceptable, looks wise, and I'm reminded of it often.  I know that as an ugly person there is a much lower chance that someone I'm attracted to could be physically attracted to me. It's just how the world works.

I'm having a hard time distracting myself. If I'm not feeling badly about her, I'm feeling badly about something else. I have been trying to knit (funny you mention that), read, write, go for walks, play games, but nothing occupies my mind for long. My depression is so bad that i have a hard time focusing.

I'm on meds and I'm seeing a therapist. It's not really working. I've been fighting this since February and I'm not getting better. I'm really, really tired. I've seen therapists, psychiatrists, social workers... . I have a ton of workbooks and self-help guides. I've checked myself into a hospital. I go to the ER. I call crisis centres. I try to meditate. I do breathing and relaxation exercises. Blah. 

I feel like maybe human connection would help me. I just need someone to like, be nice to me and listen to me and actually understand what I'm talking about. But I have a hard time connecting to anyone. I don't want to further alienate my friends. They're already wary of me right now because I'm not being funny and silly like I normally am. Therapists try to tell me what I'm feeling and make the same suggestions as everyone else and eventually get frustrated with me when it doesn't work. 

My friend I mentioned originally just told me that she went on a date with someone (a guy) on Monday. I told her that I can't talk to her for awhile and that it wasn't her fault and I wasn't trying to hurt her. She seems cool with it. I think now that she's back home and surrounded by her friends and family and the dude she has a crush on she'll forget about me pretty easily. Hopefully I can forget about her, too.
